### Alone with God
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/today-s-insight-july-27-2012.html
Passage: Isaiah 30:15
Points:
- Some of the Holy Spirit's most profound work occurs in solitude rather than in public settings.
- Believers must intentionally schedule time away from routine to be alone with God.
- Spending quiet time outdoors in nature helps clear away mental fatigue and distraction.
- Embracing quietness silences the clamor of daily life so we can truly hear God.
